VS Code tasks available:

- `npm: install` — Runs `npm install` to install dependencies.
- `npm: dev` — Runs `npm run dev` to start Next.js in development mode.
- `prisma:migrate` — Runs `npx prisma migrate dev --name init` to apply migrations interactively.

Use the Run Task command (Ctrl+Shift+B) or the Tasks panel to execute these.
